segments.text: my rental died by evergreen falls right under the wreath on city hall i kicked the tired
blameless snow a woman said that won't make it go she owned the bakery you were my name
though i'd never seen her in my life she handed me coffee took my keys said christmas trouble comes
and threes
The inn had one room
naturally
Her father played matchmaker
casually, I said I'm leaving
when roads are clear
The whole town smiled like
they didn't hear
I'm snowbound on an evergreen
falls where mistletoe hangs in the
hardware stalls, I came for a meeting
a clean escape
Now I'm frosting stars on a
gingerbread plate
This can't be love, it's much too neat
There's a choir rehearsing across the street
But every time she laughs, my big plans stall
I'm snowbound in Evergreen Falls
Her bakery faced a corporate bid
From the very same company where I lived
Where I lived
My briefcase held the closing page
She caught me reading it backstage
At the pageant dress, that's St. Nick
The beard fell off, the children screamed
She saw that logo shut the door
Said you knew what you came here for
The snow plow creared the county line
My boss said sign by closing time
I watched her turn the window dark
Then heard the choir out in the park
i'm snowbound in evergreen falls where everybody knows when somebody calls i came for a signature
sharp and fast now i'm wondering what i planned to last this might be love and that seems strange
for a man to pack no clothes to change you won't look back my courage crossed i'm snowbound in
Evergreen Falls I tore that contract beneath the clock
Bought one burnt cookie in half the block
Not as a hero, not as a scheme I cashed out the corner of my old dream
She said, big city man, what happens next? I said, use the credits if I read the text
She tried not to smile, then pulled me near
While somebody rang every bell we could heed
Wish no bell in Evergreen Falls
Putting fresh white paint on the bakery walls
Her father's pretending he planned it all
My old boss keeps getting sent to voicemail
This must be love, it's loud and sweet
With flour on my coat and I set my fee
I miss my flight but I found my call
Here with her in Evergreen Falls
When spring nuts know from the old town square
I still wake up and find her there
No borrowed miracle, no scripted sign
Just her warm hand closing over mine
I came here certain, I knew it all
Now I choose Evergreen Falls
